Critical value computed internally by JDemetra+ for outlier detection

Source: R/get_functions.R
calcOutlierCrit.Rd

Transcribes the thresholds the engines apply when the outlier specification leaves the critical value unset: x13 uses max(advancedComputer(0.05)(n), 2.8), an extreme-value approximation for the 95% quantile of the maximum of n standard normal variables; tramoseats uses max(simpleComputer()(n), 2), i.e. 3.3 up to 50 observations, rising by 0.0025 per observation up to 4.3. Verified against the jdplus implementation (X13Utility.calcCv, TramoUtility.calcCv) via rJava.

Usage

calcOutlierCrit(n, method = c("x13", "tramoseats"))

Arguments

n

Number of observations of the estimation domain

method

Either "x13" or "tramoseats"

Value

The critical value.
